wrap_environment_csv_logging: wrap a bsuite environment with CSV logging to save experiment results to a directory
create_csv_logger: create a Logger instance that saves experiment data rows to a CSV file via Pandas
write_data_to_csv: call the Logger write method to append a data row and persist the full CSV file
review_logger_init: review the Logger __init__ method to understand how bsuite_id is sanitized and the save path is constructed
refactor_logger_write: refactor the Logger write method to support incremental CSV appends instead of rewriting the entire file
